profile.summary: MyDCD Berhad specializes in the integration and maintenance of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection (MEPF) systems, and related products and services for data centers in Malaysia. The company provides integration of MEPF systems where it manages the entire process, including engineering support, supply and installation, as well as testing and commissioning. The company's mechanical system in a data centre focuses on thermal management through cooling systems, such as ACMV systems including containment systems and heat rejection systems. Its electrical subsystems include incoming power supply and distribution, uninterrupted power supply, and other electrical systems. It also focuses on providing plumbing/process utility solutions within end-user premises, including both internal and external piping, as well as process piping systems. Additionally, it provides active fire protection solutions, including water-based suppression sprinklers, and mechanical elements that control gas-based suppression systems. The company serves three types of data centers, namely enterprise, colocation, and hyperscale. MyDCD Berhad was founded in 2011 and is based in Cyberjaya, Malaysia.
profile.zh: MyDCD Berhad 成立于 2011 年，总部位于马来西亚 Cyberjaya，专注于为马来西亚的数据中心提供机械、电气、管道和消防（MEPF）系统的集成与维护服务。公司服务于企业级、托管型和超大规模三种类型的数据中心。
lines: MEPF 系统集成：管理从工程支持、供应安装到测试调试的整个流程，客户为马来西亚的数据中心。
机械系统：专注于数据中心的热管理，包括 ACMV 系统（如 containment 系统和热排放系统）等冷却系统。
电气子系统：涵盖进线电源供应与分配、不间断电源及其他电气系统。
管道/工艺公用设施解决方案：为终端用户场所提供内部和外部管道以及工艺管道系统。
主动消防解决方案：包括水基抑制喷淋系统和控制气体抑制系统的机械元件。
lines_en: MEPF System Integration: Manages the entire process including engineering support, supply and installation, testing and commissioning for data centers in Malaysia.
Mechanical Systems: Focuses on thermal management for data centers, including ACMV systems such as containment systems and heat rejection systems.
Electrical Subsystems: Includes incoming power supply and distribution, uninterrupted power supply, and other electrical systems.
Plumbing/Process Utility Solutions: Provides internal and external piping as well as process piping systems within end-user premises.
Active Fire Protection Solutions: Includes water-based suppression sprinklers and mechanical elements for gas-based suppression systems.
